svg.aria-label: ממוצע עיבור לחיצה (με) מול עומק · כל 19 השלבים
svg.title: ממוצע עיבור לחיצה (με) מול עומק · כל 19 השלבים
svg.desc: Circles are unchanged strain-gauge estimates. Squares identify source-workbook boundary points: zero incremental head force and the recorded stage load at each separate cell face. Dashed boundary connections span uninstrumented intervals and are drawing guides, not extra measurements. Cell-face strain and stress are equivalent model values derived from the boundary force. No force line crosses the cell thickness.
